authorization.source: founder request in current Codex task
authorization.scope: one 2K paid Higgsfield restyle candidate for each of three supplied verified scenes

scenes.hero_asset_gate: Golden Gate environment plus the approved rose-gold Signature monogram sculpture; preserve the five-product preorder story and do not substitute a generic luxury prop
scenes.authority_state: mapped: SG-005 plus SG-001 male, SG-015 center, SG-002 plus SG-003 right; physical source photos override dossier color drift
review_findings: The left male is not wearing exact SG-005 plus SG-001 product truth; the Bay Bridge shirt and continuous daytime bridge-print shorts were replaced by generic rose and striped interpretations.
SG-015 is directionally closest but loses sleeve chevrons, pocket piping and rainbow ankle cuffs.
SG-002 plus SG-003 are recognizable but their artwork and photographic print were redrawn.
The Signature monument is incomplete and altered.

scenes.hero_asset_gate: Black Rose script/font statue only; do not reuse the rose-in-star sculpture or the crew-and-jogger hero device
scenes.authority_state: mapped: BR-005 hoodie plus BR-007 four-angle physical shorts male; BR-004 hoodie worn long female; protected Black Rose font statue
review_findings: BR-005 large artwork moved from the required wearer-left hip/body to the forearm and its geometry was simplified.
BR-007 OAKLAND and Love Hurts typography, mesh panels, marks, pocket and hem construction were approximated.
BR-004 silhouette is directionally correct but its embroidery was redrawn rather than protected.
The font statue was regenerated with changed lettering, rails, rose treatment and pedestal geometry.

scenes.hero_asset_gate: approved mint-and-lavender garment graphic integrated as the scene device with Bay Bridge atmosphere; no unrelated statue
scenes.authority_state: mapped: SG-006 male with non-product black pants; SG-013 plus SG-014 female; approved Signature SR rose graphic
review_findings: SG-006, SG-013 and SG-014 roles, silhouettes and placements are directionally correct, but all embroidery was redrawn and the mint color shifted toward cyan.
The approved Signature SR rose graphic became a small loose floor object instead of an upright environmental hero monument.
The revised cast request conflicts with the current founder lock; promotion requires an updated role contract and a hash-bound approved SG-006 male source.

fail_closed_rules: No candidate may be promoted from provider success alone.
Any altered SKU construction, artwork, colorway, logo placement, or product pairing fails product fidelity.
Any missing, substituted, duplicated, or collection-incompatible hero asset fails the scene even when garments pass.
Every collection scene must contain either that collection's approved font statue or that collection's approved logo graphic; the global monogram alone is insufficient.
A hero asset from one collection may never be reused as the identity device for another collection.
Any pasted edge, mismatched lens or light, floating foot, missing contact shadow, or incoherent wet-surface reflection fails optical integration.
A failed scene receives no automatic paid retry; its issue must be classified and a bounded remediation approved first.
